text:
Anya Patel: quick update — LATAM-WEST (scl) onboarding: milestone 1 infra PRs merged, need routing + KMS handoff. pinging infra/routing/secret-ops. blockers?
Sam O'Neill: thanks. PRs? https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1195 Are we using customer-managed KMS or Redwood-managed?
Anya Patel: team decided customer-managed for now. @Kiran Shah you'll need to create key and grant decrypt to infra-role.
Kiran Shah: can do. need key alias and project tag. what's rotation?
Anya Patel: alias: projects/latam-west/scl-key. rotation 90d. tags: region=scl, env=prod.
Devon Cruz: routing question — do we do direct front-door or CDN+backends? prefer CDN for static assets. For inference traffic, route to nearest edge, then regional pool -> model pod.
Sam O'Neill: config snippet for route policy:
```
policy:
  match: country in [CL,PE,AR]
  prefer: latency
  fallback: usw3
```
Devon Cruz: also need firewall egress rules to allow storage to gcs-latam. Ops: allow 10.2.0.0/16?
ops-bot: deploy started for infra/latam-west - job 9845 - will post updates.
ops-bot: deploy success for subnet and loadbalancer (9845) :white_check_mark:
Kiran Shah: key created, granted to infra-role. posted ARN in #secrets-ops.
Anya Patel: thx. @Sara Liu can you validate data residency flow for logs? need logs kept in-cluster for 30d and not forwarded externally.
Sara Liu: yes, will add retention policy and verify in console. created ticket INT-4123. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Devon Cruz: code review ping @Sam O'Neill for routemanager PR 1234 — small change to geo-match.
Sam O'Neill: on it, will review today.
Anya Patel: next milestone: canary traffic (1%) next Tue. owners: infra/Devon Cruz, routing/Sam O'Neill, security/Kiran Shah. Doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/latam-west-onboard
Sara Liu: quick Q: do we need SOC approval for locale config?
Kiran Shah: not for initial canary but we need audit log enabled. done.
Anya Patel: ok closing loop — if no more blockers I'll schedule canary and send calendar invite. :calendar:
Devon Cruz: +1
Sam O'Neill: +1
ops-bot: scheduled canary for 2026-04-07 16:00 UTC
